description: Floating map control bar: basemap switcher, search, measure, zoom, share, and a configurable action button.

descriptionFull.title: A floating horizontal toolbar rendered over the map. Each feature can be enabled or disabled independently.

name: MapControl

components.name: Basemap switcher
components.description: Show the basemap style selector button.

components.name: Zoom
components.description: Show the zoom in / zoom out buttons.

components.name: Share
components.description: Show the share button (copy link, export PNG/PDF).

rows.name: Action Button
rows.description: Configure an optional action button displayed at the end of the control bar.

components.name: Button Text
components.description: Text shown on the action button. If empty, the button reads 'Analyze area'. The button is shown whenever Button Link is set.

components.name: Button Link
components.description: An external http(s) URL (opened in a new tab); one of 'panels:show:PANEL_ID', 'panels:hide:PANEL_ID', 'plugins:show:PLUGIN_ID', 'plugins:hide:PLUGIN_ID' (e.g. 'panels:hide:left-panel', 'plugins:show:DrawTool'); or a custom event name, which is emitted as-is. Event names should be namespaced (e.g. 'plugin:mapcontrol:analyze'). Leave empty to hide the button.

components.name: Button Icon
components.description: Optional Material Design Icons class for a glyph shown ahead of the button text, e.g. 'mdi mdi-chart-box mdi-18px'. Setting one also lets the button shrink to just the glyph when the control bar is too narrow for the text; leaving it empty keeps the text visible at every width.
